CustomField.label: Category
CustomField.description: Optional grouping used to organize checks within a longer card. Choose the outcome this check protects: "Completeness", "Consistency", "Timeliness", "Eligibility", "Readiness", "Risk", "Compliance", or "Relationship coverage". Leave blank to leave the check ungrouped. Category is display grouping only and has no effect on whether the check passes or fails.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Groups related checks on the card by outcome, e.g. "Completeness" or "Compliance". Blank = ungrouped. Does not affect pass/fail.
